selection: Every historical difference in committed candidate09 reports, expected Mesh-LOAM only. Require committed candidate/frozen reports to confirm this exact set before output. Diagnostic parameters transfer unchanged from02/01; no registration setting is selected and no estimator is rerun.

position_error: First-pose-normalized estimated position versus the same evaluated GT; no fitted alignment or rescaling.
paired_gap: Euclidean position difference between first-pose-normalized historical and current estimates. Rank inherited fixed blocks by gap at end minus gap at start; retain every block and every frame.
